eyebrow: Choosing exactly the columns you want
caption: The PySpark equivalent of Lesson 24's Pandas double-bracket selection.

eyebrow: Three ways to reference a column
code:
from pyspark.sql.functions import col

trips.select("fare_amount")          # plain string
trips.select(trips.fare_amount)      # dot notation
trips.select(col("fare_amount"))     # the col() function
caption: All equivalent here — but col() is needed for renaming and transforms.
.alias() only works on a col()-style reference, not a plain string.
